import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    ans = 0
    for i in range(0, 100000000, 25):
        test = str(i)
        if len(test) != len(s):
            continue
        x_value = None
        works = True
        for j in range(len(s)):
            if s[j] == 'X':
                if x_value is None:
                    x_value = test[j]
                if test[j] != x_value:
                    works = False
                    break
            elif s[j] != '_':
                if test[j] != s[j]:
                    works = False
                    break
        if works:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
